name: Klara Steiner
bio:
Klara's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a childhood fascination with engineering and a summer job at a small machining shop near Spielberg. She quickly discovered her passion for precision and a keen eye for detail, leading her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, she spent several years in the automotive industry, honing her skills in quality assurance and process optimization. Her meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to excellence caught the attention of Caterham Academy, where she now ensures every component meets the highest standards.

At Caterham, Klara is known for her rigorous testing protocols and uncompromising standards. She believes that quality control is not just about identifying defects, but about proactively preventing them. Her demanding nature pushes the team to strive for perfection, and her deep understanding of engineering principles makes her a valuable asset in identifying potential weaknesses in design and manufacturing. She is driven by the pursuit of flawless performance and the satisfaction of knowing that her work contributes to the team's success on the track.

Klara's distinctive approach lies in her ability to blend technical expertise with a keen understanding of human factors. She recognizes that even the best designs can be compromised by poor execution, so she emphasizes clear communication and collaboration between engineering, manufacturing, and trackside personnel. Her commitment to continuous improvement and her unwavering pursuit of perfection make her a formidable force in the world of motorsport quality control.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Klara is a woman of medium height with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting observations and measurements.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of Swiss-made calipers for all critical measurements.
